response.why: Cast Sheoldred! It's my win condition — 4/5 deathtouch with drain-gain. Mana value 4 means Cut Down cannot hit it (Cut Down only kills 2-cost creatures — my earlier Drowner deaths confirm). Only GftT/Anoint could remove it. All Sheoldred leaves show her on board, opp at 18 already. Preacher and Curiosity are weaker follow-ups saved for later.
response.plan: Cast Sheoldred {2}{B}{B} now. Sheoldred (mv 4) is safe from Cut Down. If they GftT/Anoint, they've spent removal. Follow with Preacher T8 and flash Enduring Curiosity for card draw engine.
